tier_of_run_ruling: MAX IS RIGHT. It is consumed only as `declared > max(run_tiers)`, an upper bound, and the outer composition across a record's runs is already max, so max-within-a-run is the consistent operator; min would falsely cap a genuinely crypto-scale sweep carrying a toy calibration cell. NAMED LIMIT ON THE RECORD: field_bits is a DECLARED list, not an EXECUTED-CELL list, so one large cell added to a sweep raises the ceiling for the whole evidence record. A coarse guard against AGENTS rule 7, not a defence.
